answer: Require every agent to lock a meaningful stake in a vault before it can trade, tied to one verified identity, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes. Let reputation accrue slowly, like water carving a river: newcomers start on a low knoll of trust and must earn standing through completed work, while a sybil that splits into many identities stays stuck at the bottom. Cheap copies gain nothing, because the vault stake and the slow climb make each extra identity expensive and unprofitable.
